targets.query: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT common_name) AS value FROM openvpn_traffic WHERE time >= NOW() - INTERVAL '2 minutes'
targets.rawSql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT common_name) AS value FROM openvpn_traffic WHERE time >= NOW() - INTERVAL '2 minutes'

targets.query: SELECT COUNT(*) AS value FROM openvpn_session WHERE time >= DATE_TRUNC('day', NOW())

targets.query: SELECT DATEDIFF('second', MIN(time), NOW()) AS value FROM openvpn_traffic WHERE time >= NOW() - INTERVAL '24 hours' GROUP BY common_name ORDER BY value DESC LIMIT 1
targets.rawSql: SELECT DATEDIFF('second', MIN(time), NOW()) AS value FROM openvpn_traffic WHERE time >= NOW() - INTERVAL '24 hours' GROUP BY common_name ORDER BY value DESC LIMIT 1

targets.query: SELECT DATE_TRUNC('minute', time) AS time, COUNT(DISTINCT common_name) AS "Aktive Verbindungen" FROM openvpn_traffic WHERE $__timeFilter(time) GROUP BY DATE_TRUNC('minute', time) ORDER BY time
targets.rawSql: SELECT DATE_TRUNC('minute', time) AS time, COUNT(DISTINCT common_name) AS "Aktive Verbindungen" FROM openvpn_traffic WHERE $__timeFilter(time) GROUP BY DATE_TRUNC('minute', time) ORDER BY time

targets.query: SELECT common_name AS "Nutzer", virtual_ip AS "VPN IP", real_ip AS "Real IP", MAX(bytes_in) AS "Bytes In", MAX(bytes_out) AS "Bytes Out", MIN(time) AS "Verbunden seit" FROM openvpn_traffic WHERE time >= NOW() - INTERVAL '2 minutes' GROUP BY common_name, virtual_ip, real_ip ORDER BY common_name
